The main counterpoint is frontal/cortical involvement, which can be seen in IDH-mutant astrocytoma or oligodendroglioma, but this is outweighed by the age and high-grade infiltrative enhancing-necrotic phenotype. Therefore the best MRI-based estimate is IDH-wildtype.

overall_comment: Predictions are based only on conventional structural MRI metadata without DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, SWI/GRE, or histopathology. The imaging pattern is strongly aggressive and glioblastoma-like, but molecular confirmation remains required, especially because frontal/cortical location provides some overlap with IDH-mutant and oligodendroglial tumors.
